# marmite 0.2.7 — AREA: feeds (RSS 2.0 + JSON Feed)

All observations are from black-box runs of `/tmp/orig/marmite_ref`.
Raw artifacts: `/tmp/probe/artifacts/feeds/` (see `canonical/`, `rich-input/`,
`rich-output/`, `escaping/`, `desc-types/`, `minimal/`).

---

## 1. Which files are produced

Feed writing is logged (at `-v`) by the module `marmite::feed`:

```
[<ISO8601Z> INFO  marmite::feed] Generated /abs/path/to/out/index.rss
[<ISO8601Z> INFO  marmite::feed] Generated /abs/path/to/out/index.json
```

For every *group* of **posts** (content with a `date`), marmite writes
`<name>.rss`, and — only when JSON Feed is enabled — `<name>.json`, into the
site output root (or into `<output>/<site_path>/` when `site_path` is set).

| group kind | feed file name (`<name>`) | produced when |
|---|---|---|
| stream `index` (the default stream) | `index` | ≥1 post whose stream is `index` |
| any other stream `S` | `slugify(S)` | ≥1 post with `stream: S` |
| tag `T` | `tag-<slugify(T)>` | ≥1 **post** carrying tag `T` |
| author `A` | `author-<slugify(A)>` | ≥1 post whose author list contains `A` |
| series `X` | `series-<slugify(X)>` | ≥1 post with `series: X` |
| archive year `Y` | `archive-<Y>` | ≥1 post dated in year `Y` |

Notes / edge cases observed:

* There is **no** `tags.rss`, `authors.rss`, `series.rss`, `streams.rss`,
  `archive.rss`, `atom.xml`, or per-month archive feed.
* **No posts at all ⇒ no feed files whatsoever.** A site with only pages
  (content without `date`) produces *no* `index.rss` / `index.json`.
* `index.rss` is *just* the stream feed of the stream named `index`. If every
  post lives in another stream, `index.rss` is **not** written (but
  `index.html` still is).
* Tag/author/series/stream/archive grouping uses **posts only** — a *page*
  carrying `tags: [x]` does not create `tag-x.rss` and is never a feed item.
* `_`-prefixed files (fragments such as `_hero.md`, `_announce.md`) are never
  feed items.
* Year in `archive-<Y>` is **not** zero padded: year 999 ⇒ `archive-999.rss`
  (while the RFC-822 date inside is `Sun, 05 May 0999 00:00:00 GMT`).
* `stream: ''` (empty string) yields the dotfiles `.rss` / `.json`, whose items
  carry `<source url="https://e.com"></source>` (empty element text), and
  `"feed_url": "https://e.com/.json"`.
* Slug collisions silently overwrite: streams `índex` and `index` both map to
  `index.rss`/`index.html`; only one survives (observed: the real `index`
  stream won). Tags `x`, `x`, `X` all map to `tag-x.rss`.
* Feeds are regenerated on **every** build (no incremental skip); `lastBuildDate`
  changes each run.
* Feeds are also listed in `sitemap.xml`, in `urls.json` under the `"feeds"`
  key (all `.rss` first, then all `.json`), and referenced from every HTML page
  as
  `<link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" title="<label>" href="<site_path>/<name>.rss">`
  and `type="application/feed+json" title="JSON <label>"`. Labels observed:
  `index`, `<stream>`, `<series-name>`, `tag: <name>` (both raw and slug
  variants are emitted when they differ), `author: <name>`, `year: <YYYY>`.

### Enabling JSON Feed

`json_feed: true` in `marmite.yaml`, or `--json-feed true`.
The CLI flag **overrides** the config in both directions:

| config | CLI | `index.json` written |
|---|---|---|
| `true` | (absent) | yes |
| `true` | `--json-feed false` | **no** |
| `false` | `--json-feed true` | yes |
| `false`/absent | (absent) | no |

---

## 2. RSS: exact byte layout

**There is no pretty-printing, no indentation, and NO trailing newline.**
The entire document is a single line, except for newlines that are part of
CDATA payloads (post HTML). No BOM. Encoding is UTF-8, non-ASCII written raw.

Prologue, byte-exact:

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><rss version="2.0" xmlns:content="http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/"><channel>
```

The only namespace declared is `xmlns:content`. There is **no** `xmlns:atom`,
no `<atom:link rel="self">`, no `<ttl>`, no `<language>`, no `<docs>`, no
`<image>`, no `<managingEditor>`, no `<copyright>`, no `<enclosure>`,
no `<comments>`, and `<guid>` has **no** `isPermaLink` attribute.

### 2.1 `<channel>` children — fixed order

1. `<title>` — the site `name` (config `name` / `--name`; default `Home`).
   `name: ''` gives `<title></title>` (the `Home` default only applies when
   the key is absent/there is no config file).
2. `<link>` — the **normalized** site URL (see §5).
3. `<description>` — the site `tagline`. Empty ⇒ `<description></description>`.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a marmite site from a single markdown body and extract the content HTML exactly."""
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, re, hashlib

BASE = "/tmp/probe/markdown-core/runs"
TPL = "@@@S@@@{{ content.html }}@@@E@@@"
FM = "---\ntitle: T\nslug: doc\ndate: 2024-01-01\n---\n"

def build(body, name=None, frontmatter=FM, extra_files=None, config=None, args=None, raw=False, tpl=TPL, fname="doc.md"):
    key = name or hashlib.sha1((body+str(frontmatter)+str(config)+str(args)+str(extra_files)).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    key = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]', '_', key)
    d = os.path.join(BASE, key)
    if os.path.exists(d): shutil.rmtree(d)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "content"))
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "templates"))
    src = body if raw else frontmatter + body
    with open(os.path.join(d, "content", fname), "w") as f:
        f.write(src)
    with open(os.path.join(d, "templates", "content.html"), "w") as f:
        f.write(tpl)
    if extra_files:
        for p, c in extra_files.items():
            fp = os.path.join(d, p)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fp), exist_ok=True)
            mode = "wb" if isinstance(c, bytes) else "w"
            with open(fp, mode) as f: f.write(c)
    if config is not None:
        with open(os.path.join(d, "marmite.yaml"), "w") as f: f.write(config)
    cmd = ["/tmp/orig/marmite_ref", ".", "out"] + (args or [])
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return d, p

def extract(d, slug="doc"):
    fp = os.path.join(d, "out", slug + ".html")
    if not os.path.exists(fp):
        return None
    s = open(fp).read()
    m = re.search(r'@@@S@@@(.*)@@@E@@@', s, re.S)
    return m.group(1) if m else ("RAWFILE:"+s)

def get(body, **kw):
    slug = kw.pop("slug", "doc")
    d, p = build(body, **kw)
    out = extract(d, slug)
    if out is None:
        return None, p, d
    return out, p, d

def show(label, body, **kw):
    out, p, d = get(body, **kw)
    print("="*72)
    print("### " + label)
    print("--- INPUT " + "-"*20)
    sys.stdout.write(body if body.endswith("\n") else body+"\n[NO-TRAILING-NL]\n")
    print("--- OUTPUT " + "-"*20)
    if out is None:
        print("!!! NO FILE. stderr:", p.stderr[-800:])
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(out if out.endswith("\n") else out+"\n[NO-TRAILING-NL]\n")
    print("--- END " + "-"*20)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Probe helper: build a site with the reference binary and print per-file output.

Usage from python:
    from probe import probe
    probe(template="{{content.title}}", files={"a.md": "---\ntitle: x\n---\nbody"})

Prints `<slug>.html: <rendered>` for each content page (skipping index/list pages).
"""
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile

BIN = os.environ.get("MARMITE_BIN", "/tmp/orig/marmite_ref")
SKIP_PREFIXES = ("404", "index", "pages", "archive", "author", "series", "stream", "tags", "tag-")


def build(files, template=None, list_template=None, config=None, args=(), binary=None, keep=False):
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="probe-")
    tdir = os.path.join(work, "templates")
    if template is not None or list_template is not None:
        os.makedirs(tdir, exist_ok=True)
        if template is not None:
            open(os.path.join(tdir, "content.html"), "w").write(template)
        if list_template is not None:
            open(os.path.join(tdir, "list.html"), "w").write(list_template)
    for name, body in files.items():
        path = os.path.join(work, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        open(path, "w").write(body)
    if config is not None:
        open(os.path.join(work, "marmite.yaml"), "w").write(config)
    out = os.path.join(work, "_site")
    p = subprocess.run([binary or BIN, work, out, *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return work, out, p


def probe(files, template="{{content.title}}", marker="@@", **kw):
    """Render `files`; print only outputs produced by the custom content template.

    The template is wrapped in `marker` so list/group pages (which use other
    templates) are filtered out of the report.
    """
    work, out, p = build(files, template=marker + template, **kw)
    results = {}
    if os.path.isdir(out):
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(out)):
            if not name.endswith(".html"):
                continue
            text = open(os.path.join(out, name)).read()
            if not text.startswith(marker):
                continue
            results[name] = text[len(marker):]
    for name, text in results.items():
        print(f"{name}: {text}")
    errs = [l for l in (p.stdout + p.stderr).splitlines() if "ERROR" in l or "WARN" in l]
    for e in errs[:12]:
        print("LOG:", e)
    shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    return results

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render all /tmp/mdA/cases/*.md through the reference binary into /tmp/mdA/golden/*.html"""
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, re

BIN = "/tmp/orig/marmite_ref"
CASES = "/tmp/mdA/cases"
GOLD = "/tmp/mdA/golden"
WORK = "/tmp/mdA/work"
S, E = "@@@S@@@", "@@@E@@@"

def main(only=None):
    if os.path.exists(WORK): shutil.rmtree(WORK)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(WORK, "content"))
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(WORK, "templates"))
    open(os.path.join(WORK,"templates","content.html"),"w").write(S+"{{ content.html }}"+E)
    open(os.path.join(WORK,"templates","list.html"),"w").write("")
    open(os.path.join(WORK,"templates","group.html"),"w").write("")
    names = sorted(n for n in os.listdir(CASES) if n.endswith(".md"))
    if only: names = [n for n in names if n[:-3] in only]
    for n in names:
        slug = n[:-3]
        body = open(os.path.join(CASES,n)).read()
        fm = "---\ntitle: T\nslug: %s\n---\n" % slug
        open(os.path.join(WORK,"content",n),"w").write(fm+body)
    p = subprocess.run([BIN, ".", "out"], cwd=WORK, capture_output=True, text=True)
    os.makedirs(GOLD, exist_ok=True)
    ok=0; miss=[]
    for n in names:
        slug=n[:-3]
        fp = os.path.join(WORK,"out",slug+".html")
        if not os.path.exists(fp):
            miss.append(slug); continue
        s = open(fp).read()
        m = re.search(re.escape(S)+"(.*)"+re.escape(E), s, re.S)
        if not m:
            miss.append(slug); continue
        open(os.path.join(GOLD, slug+".html"),"w").write(m.group(1))
        ok+=1
    print("rendered", ok, "missing", len(miss), miss[:20])
    if p.returncode!=0: print("RC", p.returncode, p.stderr[-500:])

if __name__=="__main__":
    main(set(sys.argv[1:]) or None)
